plan.title: deft update re-projects .claude/settings.json with no persistent opt-out; fail-closed hook causes friction in non-ritual repos

narratives.Description: Add a persistent opt-out so deft update does not keep re-projecting .claude/settings.json into repos that deliberately skip the fail-closed Claude ritual hooks. Removing the file must not be treated as drift that silently recreates it.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1) Add a persistent opt-out config/marker in the agent-hosts update projection module under packages/core/src/agent-hosts. 2) Add fixture tests that verify deft update does not recreate .claude/settings.json when opt-out is set and documents the escape hatch.
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer using Claude Code without session ritual, I want a persistent opt-out from projected .claude/settings.json, so that deft update stops recreating fail-closed hooks I removed.

items.title: Given a project with the documented Claude settings opt-out, when deft update runs, then it rejects re-projection of .cl

narrative.Acceptance: Given a project with the documented Claude settings opt-out, when deft update runs, then it rejects re-projection of .claude/settings.json and the file stays absent.

narrative.Acceptance: Given opt-out enabled after the settings file was deleted, when drift detection runs, then it does not recreate the file as drift repair.
